tools.name: estimate_mailing
tools.description: Count the addresses in an area of the Netherlands and price a letter to all of them (printing, envelope and postage included). Creates nothing. Use it to check the area with the user before create_print_job.

tools.name: create_print_job
tools.description: Prepare a print job with the area (and optionally the letter) and return reviewUrl: the link the user opens to see the area on the map, change it, upload or check the letter, and pay. Nothing is sent or charged until the user confirms there. The link is valid for 24 hours.

tools.name: update_print_job_area
tools.description: Replace the area of a print job made with create_print_job, while the user has not confirmed it or opened it in their account. The review link stays the same; the user reloads it to see the change.

tools.name: get_print_job
tools.description: Whether the user has confirmed a print job made with create_print_job. status pending: waiting for the user; in_account: the user opened it signed in and continues there; submitted: confirmed.
